description: A Dart service class for handling product-related operations in an e-commerce application, including fetching products, categories, and searching.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Service class for handling product-related operations such as fetching product details, categories, and search functionalities.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of products, optionally filtered by category or search query.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Fetches a single product by its ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product categories.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Searches for products matching a query string.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Retrieves products filtered by a specific category.
